notes: When nothing in your documents answers a question, the agent stops guessing: you get an alert with the customer's question, and they are told it has gone to the team - but only if an alert address or device is really set up, otherwise they get the contact from your own documents. Replies come back faster: the whole reply has one deadline, and the second AI provider is only tried if there is time for it. If neither provider answers you are now told, once per cool-off. Booking can be tried in Test agent against your real diary, then undone. Price lists from every trade read correctly: 'Rs. 2,500' is one price, leader dots are not a full stop, per-kilo prices are rates, and 'From $9,500' stays a starting price. Roman Urdu numbers, ladies/women, guests/heads and one-letter typos all find the right product.
